title: Research artefact: Criteria-Governed LLM Decision Workflows — operator, ablation package, synthetic inputs and analysis scripts
description:
Code, prompts, synthetic test inputs, frozen model outputs, analysis scripts and aggregate results for the manuscript «Criteria-Governed LLM Decision Workflows: An Auditable Architecture and Experimental Evaluation in a Production University Platform» (submitted to MDPI Machine Learning and Knowledge Extraction, Special Issue «Knowledge Discovery and Extraction with Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and Autonomous Agents»).

Includes the five-configuration governance ablation (C1 LLM only to C5 full operator) on frozen outputs of two models, the confirmatory held-out set generated after the operator was frozen (with SHA-256 chronology), an offline replay that reproduces every stored routing decision byte for byte, and the statistics (Cochran's Q, McNemar mid-p with Holm correction, Clopper–Pearson intervals). No personal data are included.
